name: El Paso County, CO
findings: El Paso County has 2,515 nonprofit organizations. 1,111 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 903 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, El Paso County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few political organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 political organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 21 would.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in El Paso County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 231 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
